description: Run Ruff fixes and formatting on Python files edited by Codex.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; & (Join-Path $r 'backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') (Join-Path $r 'scripts/format_edited_python.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
hooks.statusMessage: Fixing and formatting edited Python files with Ruff
